located_observations.observation: Substantial photographic joined wood, fastener, frayed denim and contrasting stitches still shape the upright notched ivory opening.
The stabilizer's hands hold the chair rails, and the driver's screwdriver touches its fastener. Shared object and two-person repair gesture remain concrete.
The full explanation remains three upright lines with clear word spaces; its reading body is much larger than initial and close to repair-1.

Fee/deadline/invitation are visibly larger than repair-1 and easier to read; event/date/time/place remain together, and invitation/URL remain adjacent. Place stays centered rather than sharing the event left start.

Wood and denim macros govern the irregular opening; title/slogan/date are the first anchors, then paragraph and neighboring practical groups. Image content is substantial, not a tiny add-on to a solid headline template.

All twelve entries are readable once with stable Korean counters and ordinary word spacing. The time's horizontal dash is longer than a short hyphen at native. Cut edges remain crisp; chair surface has conspicuous glossy repeated highlights.
